en.name: Aerialist
en.ability: On the night you die, you learn 1 player of each character type. If you die by execution after a good player nominated you, or by a good player's ability, you are drunk.

revisions.v1: On the night you die, you learn 1 player of each character type. If you die by execution after a good player nominated you, or by a good player's ability, you are drunk.

en.otherNightReminder: If the Aerialist died, wake them & point to 1 Minion, 1 Demon, 1 Townsfolk & 1 Outsider player.
